hypothesis: Which profilers work inside the P1 Lambda (python3.12, arm64, 10,240 MB, SnapStart) and what each costs. Each profiler arm runs P1's code with one profiler on; its cost is the difference in Lambda's own REPORT numbers against a REPORT-only control, matched by Graviton generation. 'nvidia-spi' (the operator's word) is read as NVIDIA's tooling: nvidia-smi and Nsight Systems/Compute.
